notes: Protocol-independent scenario definitions. Each scenario runs in a fresh conversation. setup.upload attaches baseline/fixtures/baseline.xlsx (tables: sales, stores) as an uploaded file source; setup.sqlite attaches a private copy of baseline/fixtures/baseline.sqlite (same tables) as a SQL database source.

Each step is one user turn. 'options' are activation/payload fields of that turn (skill, internal_action, *_confirm payloads). 'script' is the ordered list of assistant turns the stub model plays for that step; confirm fast paths call no model, so their script is empty.

'{fixture_base}' is replaced by the driver with the base URL of the local fixture HTTP server; '{sqlite_source_id}' with the source id of the attached SQLite source (SQL sources require an explicit data_context table selection per turn).
'covers' lists the category-B tools whose output the scenario records. 'expected_status' documents the known outcome; the recording stores what actually happened.
